newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week ended March 26 fell to $965.25 billion from a revised $974.84 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said Thursday.
The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 665 retail money market mutual funds rose $1.81 billion to $648.2 billion in the week.
Of the retail funds, assets of the 402 taxable money market funds rose $2.1 billion to $529 billion, while assets of the 263 tax-exempt funds fell $293.1 million to $119.2 billion, the group said.

The ICI said assets of the 324 institutional money market funds fell $11.4 billion to $317.05 billion. Of these, assets of the 261 taxable money market funds decreased $10.66 billion to $284.48 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $743.3 million to $32.57 billion, it said.
The ICI revised last week's money market mutual fund assets to $974.84 billion from $974.48 billion.
